instructions: ALWAYS check prisma/schema.prisma for correct model and field names before writing database queries
VERIFY API ENDPOINTS EXIST before adding frontend code that calls them - check src/app/api/... Never create fetch calls to non-existent endpoints
DO NOT import anything not used in the file - verify every import before committing
For Next.js route handlers, OMIT unused parameters entirely (not even _req)
ALWAYS use from next/image instead of tags
ALWAYS include all dependencies in useEffect, useCallback, and useMemo dependency arrays
Use getCSRFHeaders() for mutating requests from client
Soft deletes use deletedAt field - always filter with deletedAt: null for active records
Common models: Reward (both rewards type:TIER and add-ons type:ADDON), PledgeAddon (join table), DigitalFile
